notes: DeepSeek Harness /goal creates one armed persisted same-session objective. The installed goal-round driver emits positive-numbered user/message records with source.kind=goal and starts one distinct request series per autonomous round. This fixture requires exactly two such rounds, one durable create mutation, one durable complete mutation, and no approval request. The lifecycle asserts the stable outer arc on the real session UUID. It uses a long terminal-ready hold to skip any short inter-round ready flicker. The exact inter-round state shape remains provisional until record because the parser emits turn_done at every durable round boundary and turn_start for the next round.
